scope: Cold SQL to emitted classic schema, dataflow, Rust and stubs in the local Linux ARM64 devcontainer.
method: Fresh JVM per compiler invocation, warmed filesystem, pinned logical CPU, alternating compiler order, rotating workload order. The bootstrap interval is for the mean ratio. Tail values use separate empirical nearest-rank p95s.
